classification.difficultyReason: Identify the height as opposite and the ground distance as adjacent in the supplied right triangle, then apply tangent and multiply by 5.5.

content.prompt: At a point 5.5 metres from the base of a flagpole, the angle of elevation to the top of the flagpole is $40^{\circ}$. Determine the height, $x$ metres, of the flagpole. Give your answer to two decimal places.

spec.description: Observation point at left, flagpole at right, horizontal ground distance below the base, vertical unknown height, and sloping sight line. Decorative green ground strip and pink flag omitted.
spec.mathematics: Right triangle with adjacent side 5.5 m, opposite side x metres, a 40-degree angle at the observation point, and a right angle at the pole base.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.
